pr_title: *: allow setting @@tidb_tso_client_batch_max_wait_time to a float millisecond
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: JmPotato <ghzpotato@gmail.com>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #29698, close #29722.

### What is changed and how it works?

* Allow setting @@tidb_tso_client_batch_max_wait_time to a float millisecond.
* Fix the bug that value out of the range will only set the session variable leaving PD client unset.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [x] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1446531/141308272-0e84f543-4afc-40b3-835c-329e969498f1.png)

### Release note

<!-- bugfix or new feature needs a release note -->

```release-note
None
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

The PD client sets this truncated value.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

The PD client set the original value and failed.

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

31a4f6abbb2d32460aa844a9641af7c30a7d2cda
